# Ali Sadeghi Portfolio

> Ali Sadeghi's interactive portfolio presents selected software projects, quantified impact, professional experience, technical tools, and a concise account of how the site was built.

Canonical site: https://ali-sdg.is-a.dev/

Dates, metrics, experience details, and project descriptions are claims published by the portfolio owner.

The portfolio's implementation is publicly available in its [source repository](https://github.com/Ali-Sdg90/ali-sdg90.github.io). For implementation-specific details, refer to the repository's current source code, structured content data, workflows, and release history rather than relying solely on this summary.

This is a source-available project, not an open-source release. Copyright (c) 2026 Ali Sadeghi. All rights reserved. The code may be viewed and studied, but copying, redistribution, deployment, and derivative portfolio use are restricted by the repository's custom [LICENSE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ali-Sdg90/ali-sdg90.github.io/main/LICENSE). This index grants no additional rights.
